revision: 1. RESTRUCTURE LAYOUT FOR COHERENT HIERARCHY: Establish a primary left-aligned column for all essential visitor information (Title, Artist, Dates, Location, Hours) to ensure immediate readability and a logical reading order. Move the 'Reserve Tickets' CTA to the bottom-right corner to act as a distinct visual anchor, balancing the composition without cluttering the information column. 2. RESOLVE TYPOGRAPHIC LEGIBILITY: Separate the Artist Name ('ELARA VANCE') from the Exhibition Title. Place the Artist Name on a distinct line above the Title using high-contrast white text, small caps, and wide tracking. This preserves the experimental vertical stacking while ensuring the artist is identifiable within seconds, eliminating the illegible yellow-on-white overlap. 3. ENHANCE ATMOSPHERIC VISUALS: Replace the flat black background with a subtle radial gradient (deep charcoal to black) to create depth. Transform the central SVG artwork from rigid concentric circles into a distorted, organic mesh or blurred form to visually represent 'fragmented perception' and 'memory,' ensuring it remains contained within its area to avoid bleeding into the text. 4. SUBORDINATE DECORATIVE NOISE: Reduce the opacity and visual weight of the 'MEMORY DATA CORRUPTED' text within the artwork to prevent it from competing with the primary headline, ensuring the exhibition title remains the dominant focal point.
protected_strengths: The high-contrast, atmospheric aesthetic and the distinct separation of the CTA as a visual anchor.
The strong, clean serif typography of the main exhibition title.
The intentional use of negative space and spatial tension in the overall composition.
resolved_conflicts: Conflict: Experimental overlapping layout vs. Legibility of Artist Name. Resolution: Retain the vertical, experimental stacking but separate the Artist Name onto its own line with high-contrast styling (white, small caps) instead of overlapping it with low-contrast color.

Conflict: Grouping CTA with info (Clarity) vs. Spatial Balance (Expressiveness). Resolution: Keep CTA in bottom-right for visual balance and 'spatial tension,' but group all other logistical info (Dates, Location, Hours) in a single left column to satisfy the 'intentional reading order' mandate.

Conflict: 'Glitch' text as artistic expression vs. Visual Hierarchy. Resolution: Retain the 'MEMORY DATA CORRUPTED' text as an artistic element but significantly reduce its opacity/weight to subordinate it to the primary title, preventing it from acting as a false headline.

Conflict: Sterile geometric artwork vs. Immersive atmosphere. Resolution: Replace rigid circles with organic/distorted forms and add a radial gradient background to convey 'memory' and 'absence' without compromising the precision of the text layout.
rationale: This brief prioritizes the non-negotiable mandate that essential information (Artist, Title, CTA) must be immediately identifiable. It resolves the conflict between 'experimental composition' and 'clarity' by using typographic separation (line breaks, contrast) rather than spatial isolation. It balances 'expressiveness' (organic artwork, gradient depth) with 'craft' (clean hierarchy, legible text) by containing the visual noise within the artwork area and ensuring the text column remains pristine and readable.
